title: Under the Date Palm's Shade
intro: A tale unfolds of a soul set apart before birth, nurtured within sacred walls, and chosen to bear a sign the world had never witnessed. When accusation arose from every direction, a voice came from the most unlikely of places to silence all doubt. Can you discover who walked beneath the date palm's shade?
clues: I was dedicated to the service of the Almighty before I ever drew my first breath, a vow made by the one who carried me.
I grew up under the watchful care of a righteous guardian within the sacred chambers of a place of worship.
Whenever my guardian came to my chamber, he found with me provisions from seasons that should not have been.
I was given glad tidings of a son, though my circumstances left no room for what was promised.
I withdrew to a distant place, and there a date palm offered me shade while a stream flowed beneath.
When accusation came and questions surrounded me, I pointed to my newborn child — and he spoke from the cradle to silence every doubt.

verse: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. (19:24)
